mapper.select: SELECT initialized_at IS NOT NULL AS initialized, (SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE administrator = TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL) AS owner_id, owner_recovery_user_id AS recovery_user_id, owner_recovery_hash AS recovery_hash, transfer_target_user_id AS transfer_target_id, transfer_expires_at FROM system_state WHERE id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE system_state SET owner_recovery_user_id = #{userId}, owner_recovery_hash = #{hash} WHERE id = 1
UPDATE system_state SET transfer_target_user_id = #{targetId}, transfer_expires_at = #{expires} WHERE id = 1
UPDATE system_state SET transfer_target_user_id = NULL, transfer_expires_at = NULL WHERE id = 1
UPDATE app_user SET administrator = FALSE WHERE id = #{userId} AND administrator = TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE app_user SET administrator = TRUE WHERE id = #{userId} AND administrator = FALSE AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, nickname FROM app_user WHERE administrator = FALSE AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at, id
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET deleted_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{userId} AND administrator = FALSE AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE auth_access_link SET revoked_at = #{now} WHERE (creator_id = #{userId} OR target_id = #{userId}) AND consumed_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE auth_access_link SET revoked_at = #{now} WHERE consumed_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL
